en.title: Obsession Star Inde Navarrette Eyes Resident Evil Role: 'I Would Die Inside'
en.summary: The breakout star of the hit horror film Obsession has revealed a deep affection for the Resident Evil franchise. Navarrette is eager to step into the world of survival horror, even confirming she's been approached for an undisclosed video game project.
en.body:
From terrifying audiences in **Obsession** to potentially terrifying them in Raccoon City, **Inde Navarrette** has made it clear that the **Resident Evil** franchise holds a special place in her heart. The actress, who gained international fame following her role in the chilling film, shared her aspirations during a recent interview, expressing a fervent desire to voice a character in Capcom's iconic survival horror series.

Navarrette's love for video games is well-documented, a passion that extends beyond just casual play. She's been diving deep into the **Resident Evil** games lately, finding herself completely immersed in their atmospheric worlds. When asked about potential voice acting roles, she confirmed that she has indeed been approached for an upcoming, though unspecified, video game project, and is looking forward to starting that journey soon. She specifically mentioned a desire to tackle a smaller project first to "test the waters" before potentially diving into something more substantial, with **Resident Evil** being the ultimate dream.

> "I love that world, specifically — the Resident Evil world. I would die inside."

This sentiment is more than just a passing fancy; Navarrette's gaming roots run deep. She grew up playing a variety of titles, from party games on the PlayStation 2 with her family to narrative-heavy experiences like **Red Dead Redemption 2** and **The Last of Us**. Her enthusiasm for gaming, particularly her past Twitch streams which gained significant attention, showcases a genuine connection to the medium that resonates with fans.

## The Fan Connection

For the legions of **Resident Evil** fans, the idea of **Inde Navarrette** joining the fray is incredibly exciting. Her genuine passion and established gaming knowledge make her a natural fit, far removed from the typical celebrity voice cameo. The community has already shown immense support for her gaming endeavors, and the prospect of her bringing a character to life within the **Resident Evil** universe has sparked considerable buzz. It’s a move that feels authentic, bridging the gap between horror film fandom and dedicated gaming communities.

## What's Next

While **Inde Navarrette** has confirmed she's embarking on a new voice acting venture soon, details about the specific projects remain under wraps. Her explicit interest in **Resident Evil** certainly sets a high bar, but whether this initial project will be a stepping stone towards that goal or an entirely different gaming experience is yet to be announced. Fans will be eagerly awaiting any further updates on her burgeoning voice acting career and the possibility of hearing her voice in a future Capcom title.

content_raw: The internet’s favorite final girl says she’s branching into voice acting and would love to play a role in Capcom’s flagship horror franchise, Resident Evil. Navarrette opened up about this new career path during an interview with Variety's Tiana DeNicola in late July, saying she’s been getting into the Resident Evil games lately. When asked if she’s been approached to do any voice acting for games, Navarrette confirmed that yes, she has, and she’s starting that journey “soon,” though she didn’t mention any specifics about the projects she’ll be working on. “I wanna try something smaller to kind of test the waters, and then later, [do something] different, because video games are obviously a big interest of mine,” she revealed. “I love that world, specifically — the Resident Evil world. “I would die inside,” she continued when DeNicole described the possibility as “perfect” for her before turning the conversation toward a film adaptation of the series. “I don’t think they’ve made a Resident Evil movie yet, have they?” she asked, prompting DeNicole to bring up Zach Cregger’s upcoming film , which hits theaters this September. “Okay, I will buy a ticket,” Navarrette said. “That’s exciting!” Navarrette’s love for video games is well-chronicled at this point, with her Twitch channel going viral (before she scrubbed all of her VODs) after her breakout role in Obsession launched her to international fame. Speaking with GQ , she said she grew up playing party games on the PlayStation 2 with her mother and older brother before transitioning into narrative-driven titles like Red Dead Redemption 2 and The Last of Us . She’s also a massive Call of Duty buff, which prompted one fan to gift her a sealed 2009 copy of Modern Warfare 2 in a wholesome moment that took social media by storm. Navarrette essentially has carte blanche in terms of roles she’d like to pursue at this point, given the outstanding critical reception to her performance in Obsession. Resident Evil isn’t the only franchise she’s been publicly wishlisting lately; she also mentioned meeting with Jake Schreier , director of the upcoming X-Men film, saying she’d love to play Mystique in a future movie. For now, news of the actress’s forthcoming roles are still under wraps, but that isn’t stopping fans from bugging Schreier and Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige about fitting her in the X-Men universe somehow — and having her play the shape-shifting Mystique doesn’t sound too bad, given the hauntingly convincing way she was able to switch between Wish Nikki and Real Nikki in Obsession .
